description.content: Returns the "base" (dev branch version 1), "ours" (dev branch head) and "theirs" (default branch head) versions of a single configuration row, so a client can render a three-way diff for conflict resolution. Each side is null when the row does not exist on that side. When there is no conflict all three sides are equal. Only available in dev branches.
